en: Our facilities are designed to reduce stress, with wide feed bunks, constant access to clean water and professional support for diets and health management.

gn: Roguereko estructura ojejapóva omboguejy hag̃ua estrés, comedero ipy’aguasúva, y potĩ tapiaite ha profesional oñangarekóva dieta ha sanidad rehe.

en: Every animal is weighed and individually identified on arrival. Intake is recorded automatically by tracer: we know exactly how much each lot eats. Third-party cattle eat the same ration as ours.

de: Wir betreiben eine kontrollierte Kompostierung, die Reststoffe in organischen Dünger verwandelt, der im Sinne der Kreislaufwirtschaft auf unsere Ackerflächen zurückkehrt.
